low.label: Låg befolkningseffekt
low.interpretation: Lower-bound sensitivity, not a probability statement.

reference.label: Referenskänslighet
reference.interpretation: Middle sensitivity setting for comparison; not the most likely outcome.

high.label: Hög befolkningseffekt
high.interpretation: Upper sensitivity setting, not a probability statement.

realizationPct.rationale: Scenario range for how much of the stated job count is realised within the selected phase; not an empirical forecast.

moveSharePct.rationale: Sensitivity range for the share of workers currently outside the FA who relocate rather than commute/rotate; not calibrated from Skelleftea.

personsPerJob.rationale: Sensitivity range separating worker-only effects from accompanying household members; one worker is always modelled separately from companions in worker_household mode.

internationalRecruitmentSharePct.rationale: Explicit sensitivity range for source composition of external movers. It is not transferred from Skelleftea or treated as a forecast.

phaseYears.rationale: Sensitivity range for how quickly the realised employment effect is phased into the population scenario.

spinOffJobsPerDirectJob.rationale: User-controlled sensitivity assumption for indirect/spin-off employment. It is not an empirically calibrated multiplier in the baseline.

note: Structural scenario validation only. Passing means the scenario is transparent, bounded and reproducible; it does not establish a most-likely industrial development outcome.
